headline: What Can You Actually Verify About an AI Vendor?
subheadline: Tick what the vendor publishes, rather than what they told you in a meeting. You will get a plain-English read on where they stand, and a list of questions worth asking before you commit.
cta_label: Talk to us about assessing a vendor
disclaimer_text: This is a conversation-starter, not a certification. None of it guarantees good outcomes on its own, because certifications describe a process rather than a promise. What it does is make the questions concrete: it is now realistic to ask any AI system touching your data for the equivalent list.
source_link_label: Read the article this checklist comes from
